correctness.rationale: The explicit 4-by-5 facet classification proves maximum independent-set size three and identifies all 20 triangles. Their 30 edges have two triangle cofaces, every vertex link is a five-cycle, and Euler characteristic is two, so the core is a sphere; six leftover antipodal edges attach one-cells and give the integral wedge homology. The pair long exact sequence identifies integral H1 with the signed six-edge module, and H2 with the core orientation. Fixed-axis counts across all rotation orders give the rational A5 character. The free antipodal sphere quotient is RP2 and six reversed extra edges become collapsible pendant intervals; proof uses ordinary topology. The included standard-library checker enumerated 120 automorphisms, 20 triangles and all signed Lefschetz traces exactly.

value.rationale: The icosahedral graph is a canonical highly symmetric Platonic graph. Complete ordinary homotopy, integral symmetry lattice, and the RP2 antipodal orbit space are natural topological invariants beyond a bare face count; torsion appears in the quotient despite torsion-free original homology. The precise six-axis signed action can be reused when comparing equivariant derived graph complexes and quotient topology. This is a complete non-parametric classification of a natural fixed object; no broad generalization is claimed.
